reviews.title: Bang for your buck
reviews.comment: Just installed this GPU right after it arrived, looks wise it seems like it was refurbished well, no dust or scratches and runs well so far. Gets amazing performance in most modern games on 1080p I’m pleasantly surprised with this cards performance so far.
reviews.author: Alex A.

reviews.title: Good but breaks easy. Would not recommend.
reviews.comment: Overheats quickly and ended up greenscreening on me. Worked for the time being though but ended up overheating and crashing.
reviews.author: Kevin Jacobs

reviews.title: Refurbished but still full of dust?
reviews.comment: I expected an almost new looking card, but i had to spend quite awhile to finish the cleaning job on it before it went into my new build - otherwise OK. Still waiting on 2 more items b4 I can fire it up & make sure it works.
reviews.author: S. Todd

reviews.title: Price
reviews.comment: I need a graphics card for video capture and editing at my office but I absolutely refuse to pay the outrageous prices here.
reviews.author: MNToothdoc
